statements.label: supported
statements.text: Force-driven Emd enrichment at the outer nuclear membrane disrupted heterochromatin anchoring to the lamina and switched constitutive heterochromatin from H3K9me2,3 to H3K27me3 occupancy.
statements.evidence: Force-driven enrichment of Emd at the outer nuclear membrane of epidermal stem cells leads to defective heterochromatin anchoring to the nuclear lamina and a switch from H3K9me2,3 to H3K27me3 occupancy at constitutive heterochromatin.
statements.note: The abstract reports force-driven Emd enrichment disrupts lamina anchoring and switches the heterochromatin mark.

statements.label: not_addressed
statements.text: The same emerin–NMIIA mechanosensory pathway controls lineage commitment in human epidermal stem cells.
statements.evidence: Perturbing this mechanosensory pathway by deleting NMIIA in mouse epidermis leads to attenuated H3K27me3-mediated silencing and precocious lineage commitment, abrogating morphogenesis.
statements.note: The pathway was perturbed in mouse epidermis; the abstract never addresses human epidermal stem cells.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: NMIIA recruitment drove local actin polymerization that reduced nuclear actin, attenuating transcription and accumulating H3K27me3 at facultative heterochromatin.
statements.evidence: the recruitment of NMIIA to promote local actin polymerization that reduces nuclear actin levels, resulting in attenuation of transcription and subsequent accumulation of H3K27me3 at facultative heterochromatin.
statements.note: The abstract states NMIIA-driven actin polymerization lowers nuclear actin and builds up H3K27me3 at facultative heterochromatin.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Deleting NMIIA from mouse epidermis weakened H3K27me3-mediated silencing and triggered precocious lineage commitment, which abrogated morphogenesis.
statements.evidence: deleting NMIIA in mouse epidermis leads to attenuated H3K27me3-mediated silencing and precocious lineage commitment, abrogating morphogenesis.
statements.note: The abstract reports NMIIA deletion attenuates silencing and causes precocious lineage commitment, abrogating morphogenesis.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: After fertilization both parental genomes underwent large-scale H3K9me3 reestablishment, and their parental signal imbalance persisted until the blastocyst stage.
statements.evidence: Both parental genomes undergo large-scale H3K9me3 reestablishment after fertilization, and the imbalance in parental H3K9me3 signals lasts until blastocyst.
statements.note: The abstract reports large-scale H3K9me3 reestablishment in both genomes with a parental imbalance lasting to blastocyst.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Chaf1a proved essential for depositing H3K9me3 on LTRs and for the transcriptional repression that followed.
statements.evidence: Chaf1a is essential for the establishment of H3K9me3 on LTRs and subsequent transcriptional repression.
statements.note: The abstract identifies Chaf1a as essential for H3K9me3 establishment on LTRs and the ensuing repression.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Rebuilding of H3K9me3 on LTRs helped silence the active transcription that DNA demethylation had set off.
statements.evidence: The rebuilding of H3K9me3 on LTRs is involved in silencing their active transcription triggered by DNA demethylation.
statements.note: The abstract reports H3K9me3 rebuilding on LTRs silences transcription triggered by DNA demethylation.

statements.label: not_addressed
statements.text: H3K9me3 reprogramming dynamics in human early embryos mirror those mapped in mouse.
statements.evidence: Here, we map the genome-wide distribution of H3K9me3 modifications in mouse early embryos.
statements.note: The study mapped H3K9me3 only in mouse embryos and says nothing about human early embryos.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Upon fertilization, promoter H3K27me3 showed extensive loss at Hox and other developmental genes.
statements.evidence: we observed extensive loss of promoter H3K27me3 at Hox and other developmental genes upon fertilization.
statements.note: The abstract reports extensive loss of promoter H3K27me3 at Hox and other developmental genes after fertilization.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Using the ultra-sensitive STAR ChIP-seq method, the study profiled H3K27me3 across 14 developmental stages of mouse gametogenesis and early development.
statements.evidence: STAR ChIP-seq, we investigated H3K27me3 across 14 developmental stages along mouse gametogenesis and early development.
statements.note: The abstract reports profiling H3K27me3 across 14 developmental stages by STAR ChIP-seq.

statements.label: not_addressed
statements.text: H3K27me3 inherited from oocytes is required for normal blastocyst formation.
statements.evidence: The resulting allele-specific H3K27me3 patterns persist to blastocysts before being converted to canonical forms in postimplantation embryos, where both H3K4me3/H3K27me3 bivalent promoter marks are restored at developmental genes.
statements.note: The abstract reports the patterns persist to blastocyst but never tests whether they are required for blastocyst formation.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Sperm H3K27me3 was globally erased, whereas distal H3K27me3 was inherited from the oocyte.
statements.evidence: global erasure of sperm H3K27me3 but inheritance of distal H3K27me3 from oocytes.
statements.note: The abstract contrasts global erasure of sperm H3K27me3 with inheritance of distal oocyte H3K27me3.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: snHi-C of mouse knockout embryos showed the zygotic genome folds into loops and domains that critically depend on Scc1-cohesin, with Wapl setting their size and linear density.
statements.evidence: we demonstrate that the zygotic genome folds into loops and domains that critically depend on Scc1-cohesin and that are regulated in size and linear density by Wapl.
statements.note: The abstract shows zygotic loops and domains depend on Scc1-cohesin and are sized by Wapl.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Fertilization assembles higher-order chromatin structure from a condensed maternal and a naive paternal genome to produce a totipotent embryo.
statements.evidence: Fertilization triggers assembly of higher-order chromatin structure from a condensed maternal and a naïve paternal genome to generate a totipotent embryo.
statements.note: The abstract states fertilization assembles higher-order chromatin structure to make a totipotent embryo.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Maternal and paternal chromatin loop sizes showed distinct effects, likely reflecting differences in loop-extrusion dynamics and epigenetic reprogramming.
statements.evidence: we discovered distinct effects on maternal and paternal chromatin loop sizes, likely reflecting differences in loop extrusion dynamics and epigenetic reprogramming.
statements.note: The abstract reports distinct effects on maternal versus paternal loop sizes.

statements.label: not_addressed
statements.text: Cohesin-dependent loop extrusion in the one-cell embryo is required for subsequent zygotic genome activation.
statements.evidence: Our simulations and experimental data provide evidence that cohesin-dependent loop extrusion organizes mammalian genomes over multiple scales from the one-cell embryo onward.
statements.note: The abstract shows loop extrusion organizes the genome but never links it to zygotic genome activation.

statements.label: not_addressed
statements.text: Boosting SlDML2 activity accelerates ripening in tomato fruit.
statements.evidence: we generated loss-of-function mutant alleles of a tomato gene, SlDML2
statements.note: The study disrupted SlDML2 by loss of function and never tested whether increasing its activity speeds ripening.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: In the tomato mutant fruits, increased DNA methylation appeared across thousands of genes.
statements.evidence: In the fruits of the tomato mutants, increased DNA methylation was found in thousands of genes.
statements.note: The abstract reports increased DNA methylation across thousands of genes in the mutant fruits.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: The affected genes spanned hundreds of ripening-induced genes plus many genes normally silenced during ripening.
statements.evidence: These genes included not only hundreds of ripening-induced genes but also many ripening-repressed genes.
statements.note: The abstract reports the genes included hundreds of ripening-induced and many ripening-repressed genes.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: SlDML2 was critical for tomato fruit ripening, and active DNA demethylation was required both for switching on ripening-induced genes and for inhibiting those normally silenced during ripening.
statements.evidence: active DNA demethylation is required for both the activation of ripening-induced genes and the inhibition of ripening-repressed genes.
statements.note: The abstract concludes demethylation is needed to activate ripening-induced genes and inhibit ripening-repressed ones.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: The H3K27 demethylase KDM6A/UTX was oxygen sensitive, whereas its paralog KDM6B was not.
statements.evidence: the H3K27 histone demethylase KDM6A/UTX, but not its paralog KDM6B, is oxygen sensitive.
statements.note: The abstract reports KDM6A/UTX is oxygen sensitive while its paralog KDM6B is not.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: When KDM6A was absent, H3K27 demethylation was prevented and cellular differentiation was blocked, mirroring hypoxia.
statements.evidence: KDM6A loss, like hypoxia, prevented H3K27 demethylation and blocked cellular differentiation.
statements.note: The abstract reports KDM6A loss, like hypoxia, blocks H3K27 demethylation and differentiation.

statements.label: not_addressed
statements.text: Pharmacologically inhibiting KDM6A mimics hypoxia-induced methylation changes in tumor cells.
statements.evidence: Oxygen sensing is central to metazoan biology and has implications for human disease.
statements.note: The abstract notes disease implications but never tests pharmacological KDM6A inhibition or tumor cells.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Independently of HIF and 2-HG, hypoxia promotes histone methylation.
statements.evidence: hypoxia promotes histone methylation in a HIF- and 2-HG-independent manner.
statements.note: The abstract reports hypoxia promotes histone methylation without HIF or 2-HG.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: In NPCs the Xi chromosome lacked active/inactive compartments and TADs, except around genes escaping XCI.
statements.evidence: in NPCs, the Xi chromosome lacks active/inactive compartments and topologically associating domains (TADs), except around genes that escape XCI.
statements.note: The abstract reports the Xi lacks compartments and TADs except around escapee genes.

statements.label: not_addressed
statements.text: DNA accessibility at escapee promoters in NPCs depends on ongoing transcription of those genes.
statements.evidence: Escapee gene clusters display TAD-like structures and retain DNA accessibility at promoter-proximal and CTCF-binding sites.
statements.note: The abstract reports escapees retain accessibility but never tests whether that requires ongoing transcription.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Using allele-specific Hi-C, ATAC-seq and RNA-seq, the study showed Xist and the DXZ4-containing boundary shape Xi chromosome structure.
statements.evidence: We demonstrate a crucial role for Xist and the DXZ4-containing boundary in shaping Xi chromosome structure
statements.note: The abstract demonstrates Xist and the DXZ4 boundary shape Xi chromosome structure.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Deleting the boundary disrupted mega-domain formation, while Xist induction started boundary formation and the loss of DNA accessibility.
statements.evidence: Deletion of the boundary disrupts mega-domain formation, and induction of Xist RNA initiates formation of the boundary and the loss of DNA accessibility.
statements.note: The abstract reports boundary deletion disrupts mega-domains while Xist induction drives boundary formation and loss of accessibility.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Sox2 and its SCR enhancer showed no enhanced spatial proximity, and their spatial dynamics stayed limited over tens of minutes.
statements.evidence: Sox2 and SCR show no evidence of enhanced spatial proximity and that spatial dynamics of this pair is limited over tens of minutes.
statements.note: The abstract reports no enhanced Sox2-SCR proximity and limited spatial dynamics over tens of minutes.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Sox2 transcription happened in short, intermittent bursts that showed no association with enhancer proximity.
statements.evidence: Sox2 transcription occurs in short, intermittent bursts in ESCs and, intriguingly, we find this activity demonstrates no association with enhancer proximity
statements.note: The abstract reports bursty Sox2 transcription with no association to enhancer proximity.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: The findings support an unexpected mechanism in which enhancer control of Sox2 expression is uncoupled from enhancer proximity.
statements.evidence: supports an unexpected mechanism for enhancer control of Sox2 expression that uncouples transcription from enhancer proximity.
statements.note: The abstract concludes enhancer control of Sox2 is uncoupled from enhancer proximity.

statements.label: not_addressed
statements.text: Other pluripotency enhancers in ESCs also regulate their targets without stable physical contact.
statements.evidence: Enhancers are important regulatory elements that can control gene activity across vast genetic distances.
statements.note: The study examined only the Sox2-SCR pair and never tested other enhancers.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: In Mll3/4 catalytically deficient cells, losing enhancer H3K4me1 partly lowered H3K27ac yet barely changed transcription at enhancers or promoters.
statements.evidence: Loss of H3K4me1 from enhancers in Mll3/4 catalytically deficient cells causes partial reduction of H3K27ac, but has surprisingly minor effects on transcription from either enhancers or promoters.
statements.note: The abstract reports H3K4me1 loss partly reduces H3K27ac but has minor effects on transcription.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: In the genes with lowered expression, polymerase levels fell within gene bodies but held at promoters, hinting at pause-release defects.
statements.evidence: downregulated genes exhibit reduced polymerase levels in gene bodies, but not at promoters, suggestive of pause-release defects.
statements.note: The abstract reports reduced gene-body polymerase in downregulated genes, pointing to pause-release defects.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Depletion of Mll3/4 proteins coincided with downregulation of their target genes.
statements.evidence: loss of Mll3/4 proteins leads to strong depletion of enhancer Pol II occupancy and eRNA synthesis, concomitant with downregulation of target genes.
statements.note: The abstract reports loss of Mll3/4 proteins downregulates target genes.

statements.label: not_addressed

statements.evidence: our results suggest that enhancer H3K4me1 provides only a minor contribution to the long-range coactivator function of Mll3/4.
statements.note: The abstract describes a coactivator function but never identifies Mediator or any recruitment mechanism.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: Binding of repressive marks such as H3K27me3 to the EED subunit boosts the SET domain's catalytic efficiency, propagating the repressive modification.
statements.evidence: binding of repressive marks, like H3K27me3, to the EED subunit of the complex leads to enhancement of the catalytic efficiency of the SET domain and thus the propagation of this repressive histone modification.
statements.note: The abstract reports H3K27me3 binding to EED raises SET-domain catalytic efficiency, propagating the mark.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: The H3K27M mutation, seen in certain pediatric brain cancers, is tied to a global decrease of H3K27me3 in affected cells.

statements.note: The abstract links the H3K27M mutation in pediatric brain cancers to a global decrease of H3K27me3.

statements.label: supported
statements.text: PRC2 silences gene expression by trimethylating lysine 27 of histone H3 through its catalytic SET domain.
statements.evidence: Polycomb repressive complex 2 (PRC2) silences gene expression through trimethylation of K27 of histone H3 (H3K27me3) via its catalytic SET domain.
statements.note: The abstract states PRC2 silences genes via SET-domain trimethylation of H3K27.

statements.label: not_addressed
statements.text: Molecules mimicking the H3K27M peptide inhibit PRC2 in other cancer types.
statements.evidence: The structure and binding studies suggest a mechanism for the oncogenic inhibition of H3K27M.
